title: Opt-Out Management
notes: Migrated to ListPage archetype with bulk re-subscribe, per-row hover re-subscribe action, channel filter, and full-dataset CSV export. No detail drawer (opt-out records have no separate detail view worth a tab) and no relation/phone/address/currency/date fields apply to this entity. Still points at the manifest's real /marketing/opt-out endpoints (list, opt-in) instead of hijacking /contacts; wired resubscribe to POST /marketing/opt-out/:contactId/opt-in.
showcaseScript: Show contacts who unsubscribed and when
Re-subscribe a contact who asked to opt back in
